features: Editable rational 2×2 A and B cover determinant and matrix-entry multiplication practice.
Actual columns, weighted sum path, unit-square image, both exact products and both composition paths.
Signed2D area and3D volume from exact determinants; every mapped square/cube corner is linked to A times its input.
4×4 determinant is explicitly4D volume, without falsely asserting all lower-dimensional areas collapse.
Exact k-system, rank/augmented-rank distinction and particular-plus-kernel families.
Actual three-dimensional constraint-plane patches: unique point, dependent line, coincident plane, pairwise intersections without common point, and parallel inconsistency.
Near-singular rational solutions retain exact distant coordinates; drawing axes adapt and may visually obscure tiny separation.
Exact original-column basis and kernel; rank0,1,2,3 fixtures, image point/line/plane/wholeR3.
True3D sampled plane and actual cube edges/corners; face-on/edge-on camera controls keep algebraic rank.
Affine constraint planes are explicitly distinguished from linear subspaces.
4×4 rank3,3×4 rank3 and2×4 rank2 maps; all four input coordinates and all actual output coordinates retained.
Kernel coefficients change the input with invariant output; exact squared norms use all coordinates.
Coordinate-index bars and complete tables, without pretending to display4D spatial geometry.
Exact known real eigenpairs, algebraic/geometric multiplicity, rank of eigenvectors, trace and determinant.
Identity versus defective shear; explicit representative triangular matrices with spectra2/3/5 and1/2/4.
Quarter-turn special case reports±i and complex eigenvectors separately, with no real eigenline or arbitrary eigensolver claim.
Every indexed orbit point and approximate norm derived from exact rational coordinates/squared norm, with no normalization.
Eigenvalue4,n3 gives64v; nonnormal decay permits transient growth, fast-only/slow-only/zero and late decay.

additional_required_visual_evidence: Real3D constraint planes and intersections, not only RREF tables.
Bounded exact complex quarter-turn contrast, without real-only general diagonalization claims.
remaining_scope_limits: No arbitrary complex/floating-point eigensolver, SVD, pseudospectra or high-dimensional numerical-conditioning analysis.
Input matrices are limited to1–4 rows/columns and declared finite rational bounds; each interactive station has a narrower explicit domain.
3D drawings are orthographic approximations; four-coordinate bars are index plots, not4D geometry.
The seven-station count and numerical assertions are not completeness denominators.
Current shared integration, original-media preservation and the quiz8 clarification have separate integration/actual-reader evidence.
